modalLead: More for the Containers view: see what each container takes on disk, remove several at once, and get links that go to the right server.

items.text: A Size column. What each container wrote, with its image on hover; the side panel shows both.
Remove several containers at once. Tick them and press Remove, ⌫, or right-click one of the ticked rows. Running ones are stopped first, after asking.

Links that go to the right server. Until a Docker host address is set, the view says where port links point, with a button to the setting. Config → Containers gives an example and checks the address as you type.
⌫ removes, and the key legend says so. Many keyboards, a MacBook's among them, have no Delete key.
